messages:
anya: Heads up 1 1 updating the action cluster in the model row to a denser visual layout for collapsed cards. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/row-actions. Problem: when we reduce vertical padding to 8px the icon appears misaligned and focus rings clip inside the card. want to discuss accessibility tradeoffs before I ship.

mike: thanks. quick ask 1 can we avoid setting explicit height on the button? that often causes baseline shifts. share screenshot? :camera_flash:

anya: screenshot here: https://imgur.com/compact-cta. current css test: 
```css
.row-action { padding: 4px 6px; height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
.row-action--icon { transform: translateY(-2px); }
```

priya: shorter height looks crisp but fails 44px touch target. proposal: keep visual 28px but wrap with invisible hit area to meet 44px. e.g. 
```css
.hit-wrapper { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 0; margin: -8px 0; }
```
this keeps visuals but keeps tappable area.

sam: agree with wrapper approach. also the focus clipping is because .card has overflow: hidden for rounded shadow. options: 1) move actions outside overflow boundary, 2) set outline-offset on button, 3) render focus using box-shadow that fits inside. I'd prefer option 1 for predictable layout.

mike: option 1 is safest. moving the actions into an overflow-visible slot keeps shadows intact. also avoid translateY hacks on svg; instead ensure svg has correct viewBox and use align-items center. example: 
```css
.row-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.row-action svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
```
this removes pixel nudges.

priya: copy tweak: change "Run eval" -> "Run evaluation" and "Quick run" -> "Quick evaluation" for clarity. i'll add to i18n keys. also add aria-label for icon-only variants.

anya: noted, will update design tokens and i18n table. question about toasts: current success toast disappears ~1.0s which feels too fast. should we convert durations into tokens so product teams can reference them?

sam: yes. create tokens toast.duration.short/medium/long. suggest short=1200ms, medium=2200ms, long=3500ms. Keep error to long. Also add token for focus.outlineOffset = 3px so we are consistent.

design-bot: created tokens: spacing.compact=8px, spacing.touch=8px (wrapper), toast.duration.medium=2200ms, focus.outlineOffset=3px. PR created: #476. :robot_face:

mike: QA notes: test RTL and long translations; add min-width: 0 + overflow: hidden + text-overflow: ellipsis on label containers. Also ensure the icon-only state has an accessible label and visible focus.

priya: i'll add a11y test cases: keyboard nav, hit-area talkthrough (touch), screen reader label checks. will draft in the PR description.

anya: plan: update Figma, open a small PR with style changes (hit wrapper, remove translateY, center icons, outline-offset token), bump toast durations, and change copy keys. aiming for small-scope change so we can ship in the next sprint.

sam: please add a visual regression snapshot for: (1) default row, (2) long-label row, (3) icon-only. that should catch spacing regressions.

mike: +1. also include a unit test that asserts hit-wrapper increases effective bounding box (so automation can detect touch target).

anya: thanks everyone. i'll ping when PR is up for review.
